input.text: Section 5 of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000 applies, and section 6 of that Act applies.

references.literal: Section 5 of the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000

references.external_instrument: the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000

_note: _classify_instrument_kind() must classify by the name's HEAD noun (the LAST/rightmost instrument keyword), not by checking 'Regulation' before 'Act' in a fixed order — 'Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000' is an ACT (the word 'Regulation' occurs only inside the name, not as its head noun), so 'that Act' correctly matches it as the SAME kind. The old order-of-checks version classified this name as a 'regulation' purely because that word happened to be checked first, so 'that Act' (kind 'act') never matched it and fell through to 'unnamed (see note)'.
